literal: To those who live, like what the sky yielded indeed, is the grace that the beloved bestows to those who love.
translation: Like the life-giving rain that the sky yields to those who live on earth, is the grace that the beloved bestows upon those who love them.
modern: உலகில் வாழ்பவர்களுக்கு வானம் மழை பொழிந்து உதவுவது போல, காதலிப்பவர்களுக்கு அவர்கள் விரும்பும் காதலர் செய்யும் அன்பான உதவி அமைகிறது.
explanation: This couplet beautifully compares the affection of a beloved to the life-giving rain from the sky. Just as living beings depend entirely on the timely rain ('வானம்') to survive and flourish, those who love ('வீழ்வார்க்கு') depend on the grace and kindness ('அளி') shown by their beloved ('வீழ்வார்'). The word 'அளி' represents the cooling, nurturing grace that revives a pining lover, much like rain revives a parched earth. Without this grace, the lover cannot sustain life, making the beloved's love as essential as the heavens.
